definitions.explanation: the habit or act of eating food very quickly
competitive eating where participants race to consume food

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (fast, quick) + {食|く}い (eating). The rendaku changes く to ぐ.

SENSE 1 — EATING QUICKLY:
A common bad habit. Health professionals warn that {早食|はやぐ}い is associated with {消化不良|しょうかふりょう} (indigestion) and ⟦{肥満|ひまん}→肥満：13920_himan⟧ (obesity). The recommended opposite is ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{噛|か}んで→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (to chew well).

SENSE 2 — COMPETITIVE EATING:
{早食|はやぐ}い⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧ and {早食|はやぐ}い⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧ refer to speed-eating contests.
